configuration.boundary: resident state; one worker; synchronous steady-state
configuration.artifact_policy: checked rows use the source artifact; unchecked rows use without_integrity_constraints()
notes: Compilation, input construction, process startup, warmup, and final state readback are outside the timed region.
The ordinary unchecked row removes integrity predicates and their dead register computations but keeps the normal arithmetic policy.
The unchecked-fast row additionally enables algebraic zero/one-term simplification; it is an explicit weaker numeric policy, not the representative checked result.
The SIMD transcendental helpers pass native vectors on arm64 and x86_64 and retain a pointer ABI fallback on other targets.
